content.short: Genopets is a popular Move-to-Earn RPG on Solana that rewards players for their real-world physical activity.
content.description: Genopets is a revolutionary blockchain-based role-playing game that encourages users to lead an active lifestyle by rewarding real-world movement with in-game achievements and digital assets. In the Genopets metaverse, players nurture, upgrade, and battle with their digital companions, whose growth is directly linked to the user's physical activity tracked via mobile devices. The platform features a robust dual-token economy and digital ownership of assets through NFTs, fostering a vibrant player-driven economy. By combining fitness tracking with engaging gameplay and Web3 incentives, Genopets is a leading force in the Move-to-Earn movement, creating a fun and rewarding social ecosystem for global players.
content.meta: Genopets is a premier Move-to-Earn RPG on Solana, rewarding real-world physical activity with digital ownership and engaged gameplay.
